note: The standards this studio runs under for Women Worth & Wealth, taken from CLAUDE.md and the build spec in the womens-wealth- repository. A working reminder, not a compliance opinion: Becky's compliance review decides what may go out.

identity.positioning: A small group money and worth experience for women in New Orleans
identity.channel: An educational program, invoiced separately from any advisory practice
identity.note: Enrollment does not create an advisory relationship with either host. Keep the program separate from Becky's advisory practice in every piece of copy.

audienceClasses.label: Participant and applicant facing
audienceClasses.rule: Goes to a participant, an applicant or the public. Route through Becky's compliance review before it is sent.
checks: Educational framing: general education, not financial, tax, or legal advice
No product recommendation, no "you should buy"
No performance claim and no outcome guarantee
No testimonial, outcome or quote that is not real and approved
No Eternal Wealth Partners, Northwestern Mutual or broker-dealer name without approved disclosure language
Worth never tied to income: no "earn your worth"

audienceClasses.label: Professionals
audienceClasses.rule: Goes to a coordinating professional under their own engagement. Written in professional register, and it surfaces implications rather than giving advice in their discipline.
checks: Surfaces implications and timing, does not give advice in their discipline
Assigns nothing to a professional that they have not already indicated
States that the planning lead coordinates and does not direct licensed work

audienceClasses.label: Sponsors and partners
audienceClasses.rule: Sponsor and partner development. Anything they will share publicly routes through review first.
checks: No participant detail of any kind
Sponsor named publicly only with their approved wording
Any public derivative routed through review

audienceClasses.label: Internal
audienceClasses.rule: Never leaves Amy and Becky. Write it for the person doing the work.

standingRules: Educational only. Teach concepts, never recommend a product or strategy.
No performance claims, no outcome guarantees, no figures that do not trace to a source.
Never fabricate a testimonial, an outcome or a quote.
Own your worth, steward your wealth. Never tie worth to income.
Amy's lane is worth, leadership and mindset; Becky's is the money.

attribution.why: What the program claims as its own work, and what it quotes. Quoted material keeps its source every time it is used.

quoted.heading: Quoted, always with attribution
items: Shonda Rhimes, Year of Yes: the passage used for the Summit

routing.heading: What leaves the room
routing.body: The program teaches, it does not advise. A question about a participant's own situation is answered in general and routed to her own financial, tax or legal professional.
